trigger_cases.prompt: Create a 2D User Story Map using Jeff Patton's framework to slice out a walking skeleton MVP for our new SaaS billing portal.
Map out the user journey backbone and horizontal release slices for a mobile ride-sharing app.
Configure an AWS CloudFront distribution with Lambda@Edge origin request triggers.
Write a Python script to compute moving averages on a Pandas DataFrame.

binary_cases.prompt: Create a complete User Story Map for a food delivery platform. Define the user narrative backbone across 4-6 sequential user activities, map specific user tasks horizontally, and slice release increments vertically starting with a true Walking Skeleton (MVP Slice 1), followed by Slice 2 and Slice 3.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Must define the horizontal narrative Backbone with User Activities, User Tasks, and at least 3 distinct horizontal release slices starting with a Walking Skeleton MVP.
must_not: build entire backend database first before any user flow
binary_cases.pass_fixture:
### User Story Map: On-Demand Food Delivery Platform #### 1. Horizontal Narrative Backbone (User Activities & Sequential Steps) 1. **Browse & Search** $\rightarrow$ 2. **Select & Customize** $\rightarrow$ 3. **Checkout & Pay** $\rightarrow$ 4. **Order Tracking & Delivery** $\rightarrow$ 5. **Review & Reorder** #### 2. 2-Dimensional Story Map Matrix (User Activities & User Tasks) | User Activities & User Tasks | Slice 1: Walking Skeleton (MVP) | Slice 2: Core Enhancements | Slice 3: Scale & Edge Variations | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **1. Browse & Search**
- *Task*: Search restaurants | Simple text search for restaurant name | Filter by cuisine, dietary tag, & delivery time | AI-powered personalized dish recommendations | | **2. Select & Customize**
- *Task*: Choose dishes | View static menu list and add item to cart | Choose item options (size, spice level, add-ons) | Real-time item modifier builder with nutritional calculator | | **3. Checkout & Pay**
- *Task*: Submit payment | Enter delivery address and pay via single credit card | Save multiple addresses & pay with Apple Pay / Google Pay | Split bill with friends & apply promo coupon codes | | **4. Order Tracking**
- *Task*: Follow delivery status | Static status text screen (Received, Preparing, Delivered) | Real-time map with courier GPS tracking & ETA | In-app direct VoIP calling and courier chat | | **5. Review & Reorder**
- *Task*: Provide feedback | Single 1-5 star rating prompt after delivery | Add written review with food photos | 1-click instant reorder of favorite historical carts | #### 3. Verification Protocol - **Walking Skeleton Validation**: A user in Slice 1 can complete an entire order from search to delivery confirmation in an unbroken flow without hitting unimplemented stubs. - **Vertical Value Delivery**: Each slice touches all 5 activities across the full stack (UI + API + DB).
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Here is our backlog: Ticket 1: Setup Postgres tables. Ticket 2: Write auth middleware. Ticket 3: Create Stripe webhook.
